categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches src/netbase.cpp and src/i2p.cpp with P2P label, addressing proxy and I2P connection logging.
categories.rationale: Reduces log spam when configured SOCKS5 or I2P proxies are unreachable by logging repeated connection attempts at debug level rather than info or error. Adjusting log verbosity is an internally focused cleanup with marginal impact on P2P connectivity or protocol operation.
